title: Use Seedance 2.5 on Magnific’s 3D Motion Control to build your scene, set…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 on Magnific’s 3D Motion Control to build your scene, set precise camera movement, add references, then generate the video.  
Add up to 50 reference images in Magnific with Seedance 2.5 to maintain visual consistency across the generation.  
Generate up to 30-second clips with Seedance 2.5 on Magnific when you need longer continuous shots.  
Use Magnific’s edit/extend tools with Seedance 2.5 to refine the clip, extend duration, and upscale the final output to 4K.  
Use video references plus keyframe control in Magnific with Seedance 2.5 to guide motion and timing in the generated video.
